title: Comprehensive Typographic Pairings & Multi-Script Optical Architecture
summary: Curated catalog of 57 typographic pairings spanning Swiss grotesques, editorial serifs, developer monospaces, and international RTL/CJK writing systems.
whenToUse: When establishing type hierarchy, setting font-family stacks, or pairing display headlines with high-readability body copy.
whenNotToUse: Do not load more than 2 distinct font families per application to avoid network overhead and font-weight bloat.
rules: Always declare system font fallbacks matching the generic family (sans-serif, serif, monospace).
Display fonts must be constrained to headlines (h1-h3) and hero elements.
Body typography must prioritize x-height legibility and tabular figures for numbers.
Support true bidirectional typography with Arabic fallbacks (Noto Sans Arabic, Noto Naskh) for RTL symmetry.
antiPatterns: Decorative display fonts applied to dense body paragraphs or tables
Line-length exceeding 75 characters on desktop viewports
Line-height below 1.4 on multiline body text causing vertical collision
Hardcoded pixel font-sizes preventing user browser scaling
accessibilityNotes: Ensure 16px minimum base font size and fluid typography scaling with CSS clamp().
provenance: Synthesized from classical typographic proportions, modular scales, and cross-platform font rendering engines.
